title: Structure of a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Hold Payment Relative to the Monthly Payment
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — how a hold payment is built against the total monthly payment**

**Clause.** The shape of the hold payment follows the invoiced end-of-term balance:

- when that balance exceeds 2 times the lease's total monthly payment (the large-balance payment count), the hold payment is one total monthly payment in full plus the hold rate times the part of the invoiced end-of-term balance above one total monthly payment;
- when that balance is no more than one total monthly payment, the hold payment is the whole invoiced end-of-term balance;
- in every other case, the hold payment is the hold rate times the invoiced end-of-term balance.

The invoiced end-of-term balance is the end-of-term charges billed on the day the end-of-term invoice was mailed, less every end-of-term charge waiver, security deposit application and end-of-term payment posted on the lease, a waiver of a term fee such as a late charge not being taken off.

**Worked figures (hypothetical: total monthly payment $500.00, hold rate 35 percent)**

| Invoiced end-of-term balance | Band | Hold payment |
|---|---|---|
| $2400.00 | above $1000.00 | $500.00 plus 35 percent of $1900.00, that is $1165.00 |
| $1000.00 | more than $500.00, not above $1000.00 | 35 percent of $1000.00, that is $350.00 |
| $800.00 | more than $500.00, not above $1000.00 | 35 percent of $800.00, that is $280.00 |
| $500.00 | not above $500.00 | the whole $500.00 |
| $320.00 | not above $500.00 | the whole $320.00 |
